title: Dota2 Senate
problemStatement: In the Dota2 senate, senators belong to one of two parties: 'R' (Radiant) 'D' (Dire) The voting proceeds in rounds. During each round, senators act in their current order. A senator who still has voting rights may ban one senator from the opposing party. A banned senator loses all future rights. Assuming every senator acts optimally for their party, determine which party will eventually win.
input: A string representing the initial senate order.
